mapper.update: update bus_goods_stock set number = number - #{number} where goodsid = #{goodsid} and warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and number >= #{number}
mapper.select:
select s.*, g.goodsname, g.size, w.name as warehouseName from bus_goods_stock s left join bus_goods g on g.id = s.goodsid left join bus_warehouse w on w.id = s.warehouse_id
and s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
and g.goodsname like concat('%', #{goodsname}, '%')
order by s.warehouse_id, s.goodsid

select s.*, g.goodsname, g.size, w.name as warehouseName from bus_goods_stock s left join bus_goods g on g.id = s.goodsid left join bus_warehouse w on w.id = s.warehouse_id where s.goodsid = #{goodsid} order by s.warehouse_id

select s.*, g.goodsname, g.size, w.name as warehouseName, r.dangernum from bus_goods_stock s join bus_warehouse_warn_rule r on r.goodsid = s.goodsid and r.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id left join bus_goods g on g.id = s.goodsid left join bus_warehouse w on w.id = s.warehouse_id where s.number < r.dangernum order by s.warehouse_id, s.goodsid
select g.id as goodsid, g.goodsname, IFNULL(s.number, 0) as number from bus_goods g left join bus_goods_stock s on s.goodsid = g.id and s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} order by g.id
